title: Honey Garlic Chicken Bowl
subtitle: Air-fried, sticky-sweet. 6 min prep, 16 min cook.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Tops 500g tray — trim visible fat hard, air frying will render the rest.

ingredients.note: The crisp shell. Don't sub flour.
For the glaze, on top of the dredge tbsp.
For heat without changing the sweetness profile.
Yes, five. This is a garlic dish.
Oil cap. For the glaze only.

substitutions.note: Leaner, higher protein. Brine 15 min in salt water or it'll dry in the air fryer.
Cuts ~180 kcal. Bowl gets lighter, still satisfying.
Glaze loses some lacquer. Cuts ~50 kcal.

steps.text: Toss chicken chunks with 1 tbsp soy + garlic powder. Sit 5 min.
Add cornstarch, toss until every piece is dry-coated. Pat clumps apart.
Preheat air fryer 200°C / 400°F, 3 min. Steam broccoli in microwave 3 min with 1 tbsp water.
Air fry chicken in single layer, no touching, 12 min, flipping at 7.
While chicken cooks: heat a small pan low. Add sesame oil + minced garlic, 60 sec until pale gold — DON'T let it brown.
Add honey, soy, rice vinegar, sriracha. Simmer 1 min. Whisk in cornstarch slurry (1 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water). Cook 30 sec until glossy.
Tip hot chicken into glaze pan. Toss until every piece is lacquered.
Build bowls: rice base, broccoli to one side, glazed chicken centre. Sesame seeds and spring onion.

serves_with.note: If still hungry: jammy 6-min egg = +6g protein, +5g fat.

notes: Classic Chinese-takeout honey-garlic, cleaned up. Cornstarch dredge + air fryer = ~80% of the deep-fry crunch at half the fat. The garlic is fried FIRST in the sesame oil — that infuses the glaze with the deep roasty notes that ordinary chopped garlic won't give. Toss chicken in the hot glaze immediately or the shell turns to leather.
